basis: Thymic origin lies outside the listed axes; neuroendocrine histology alone establishes neither endocrine-gland disease nor an immune mechanism.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine-gland disease or a hormone disorder.

basis: Generalized epidermal acantholysis and erosions define disease. Respiratory failure is reported in 30-79%, without established direct airway or lung injury; cardiomyopathy occurs in 5-29%.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory failure in 30-79% establishes frequency, but its mechanism is unspecified and direct pulmonary injury is not demonstrated.

basis: Cytosolic thiolase deficiency is metabolic; developmental delay and chorea characterize reported affected cases, although a numerical neurologic frequency is unavailable.

decisions.neurologic: involved: developmental delay and chorea characterize the reported clinical phenotype; frequency is unquantified. The defining lesion is metabolic enzyme deficiency.

basis: Defining oral, limb and epiglottic malformations occupy three primary slots. Intellectual deficit is also explicitly defining and retained as involved under the cap; frequency unspecified.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: epiglottic hypoplasia is an explicit defining airway malformation.
decisions.neurologic: involved: intellectual deficit is explicitly defining, satisfying the diagnostic-feature exception; placed here because primary is capped at three.

basis: Lens and anterior-segment defects define disease. Malocclusion 12/12, arachnodactyly 4/5 and laxity/pes planus 1/2 establish morphology but not additional functional damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: arachnodactyly 4/5 and joint hypermobility/pes planus 1/2 establish common skeletal features, without demonstrated tissue injury or functional loss.

basis: All four named organ disorders define the syndrome. Hearing impairment is retained as involved because primary is capped at three; numerical frequencies are unavailable.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: enterocolitis is a named defining intestinal disorder.
decisions.otologic: involved: hearing impairment is a named defining feature, satisfying the diagnostic-feature exception; placed here under the three-primary cap.

basis: Triglyceride storage disorder; myopathy roughly 50-100% and hepatic disease roughly 40-80%, varying by subtype. Ichthyosis is subtype-specific; its pooled frequency is uncertain.

decisions.dermatologic: none: ichthyosis defines NLSDI but is absent from NLSDM; a qualifying frequency across the umbrella population is not established.

basis: Microspherophakia establishes intrinsic lens disease. The unspecified associated hernia does not establish disease of the bowel or another covered gastrointestinal structure.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: the record does not specify the hernia's contents or establish an intrinsic gastrointestinal lesion; bowel involvement cannot be assumed.

basis: Proximal renal tubulopathy; developmental delay 3/4 and phosphate-wasting hypophosphatemia 3/5 support involvement. CK/transaminase elevations alone establish neither muscle nor liver damage.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: hypophosphatemia in 3/5 is a common intrinsic consequence of renal phosphate wasting; electrolyte disorders belong to this axis.

basis: Inherited motor-sensory neuropathy; persistent distal muscle atrophy and structural foot deformities are characteristic. Amyotrophy is documented in 1/1 annotated patients.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: characteristic persistent denervation atrophy and foot deformities establish structural muscle and skeletal damage, beyond weakness alone; amyotrophy recorded in 1/1.
